bio.text: Jason Plummer, a Republican, represents Illinois' 55th Senate District; his office biography says he was elected to the Senate in 2018 and re-elected in 2022, and was named Republican Caucus Chair in 2026.
The biography says Plummer lives in Edwardsville, where he is president of the family-owned R.P. Lumber, and is president and chairman of the holding company Country Bancorp.
It says he graduated from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign with a finance degree and served as an intelligence officer in the U.S. Navy Reserve.
